brief: @buildthis.bisks.net Make a fake Nextdoor-style social app where users post increasingly paranoid neighborhood updates, reply in character, and vote on whether each complaint is real or completely unhinged
note: built curtaintwitcher: a fake Nextdoor feed where posts escalate from "recycling day moved" to "typing this from my neighbor's driveway," 8 neighbors auto-reply in character, and you vote REAL or UNHINGED.
